'''Caldara''' was a province on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]] during the time it was ruled by the [[Kingdom of Barseg]]. Along with its neighbor, [[Berene]], Caldara was the site of the native [[Liann]]s last stand against their oppressors. Caldara was no longer an active part of the Lianna urban landscape by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
